why: The v2 run's COOL-1 asserted the OLD post-forward bind cooldown and failed against the accepted repair (ca00bbc + bind clears the gate). This supplement runs only the corrected scenario.
stale_assertion_in_v2_receipt: releasePending right after a forward is refused with Cooldown: the bind step reads the next_attempt_at that verifyAndForward set
corrected_assertion: releasePending immediately after a successful verifyAndForward is NOT throttled: a forward that lands in Forwarded clears Entry.next_attempt_at (ca00bbc), so the bind answers ok with Shenanigans' own answer (Unbound for an unbound owner, Reserved/AlreadyReserved for a bound one) and never err Cooldown
other_cases: The other 153 passing checks of the v2 run (154 total; 133 of them were in the first-phase checkpoint) are unaffected by this supplement and remain valid at their pins; nothing else was re-run.

previous_attempt.outcome: 2 checks, 2 failed: a bug in the supplement's own post-condition (it compared Shenanigans' one-element answer list to a list of bare variants). The raw replies in that file already showed the correct behaviour (Unbound/Unbound, Bound/Reserved, next_attempt_at 0, 3.4 s after the forward). Kept for honesty; this file is the corrected rerun with fresh synthetic events (tags 115/116, so the forwards and binds are genuinely new).
